workflow: Multiple worker threads consume one shared stateful iterator backed by a native resource.
One thread reaches the end and closes the shared resource while another thread is retrieving the next item.
The second thread checked that the resource was available before the concurrent close, then continues using the released resource.
The retrieval becomes a use-after-free and can terminate the process.
summary: Concurrent iterator exhaustion closes a shared resource during another retrieval
decision_reason: The primary crash workflow is materially identical to workflow-0008: concurrent iterator exhaustion closes shared native state during another thread's retrieval, producing a use-after-free.
